sections.instruction: [Provide the purpose of the IV&V Plan. This document should be tailored to fit the particular project needs.]
sections.boilerplate: Verification looks at whether we are doing the thing right (following required processes and procedures); validation looks at whether we are doing the right thing (meeting the customers' needs). Independent approach to verification and validation (IV&V) Plan documents the approach and processes that will be used to ensure that an independent approach to the verification and validation is incorporated into the project from the beginning of the lifecycle through implementation. The IV&V Plan is created during the Planning Phase of the project as a part of the Project Management Plan. The intended audience is project stakeholders such asthe project sponsor and senior leadership.
